user.title: Install the Fire2MQTT app on your Fire TV
user.description: Fire2MQTT needs its companion app running on the Fire TV before Home Assistant can talk to it. Choose how to install it. Either way, you'll enter the device details on the next screen.

manual_install.title: Sideload the app yourself
manual_install.description:
Install the Fire2MQTT APK on your Fire TV, open it, and configure your MQTT broker plus a **device ID** in the app.

Quick sideload over ADB:
```
adb connect <fire-tv-ip>
adb install -r app-debug.apk
```

The device ID you set in the app must match the one you enter on the next screen. Submit when the app is installed and running.

config.title: Set up Fire TV Stick
config.description:
Enter a name and a unique device ID for your Fire TV Stick. The device ID must match the one configured in the Fire2MQTT app.

See [MQTT schema docs]({mqtt_schema_url}) for topic details.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Fire TV Stick
reconfigure.description: Change the MQTT topic prefix for device `{device_id}`. The prefix must match the one configured in the Fire2MQTT APK.

provision_adb.title: Provision over ADB
provision_adb.description:
First enable **ADB Debugging** on the Fire TV (Settings > My Fire TV > Developer Options), then enter its IP address. The first time you connect, accept the authorization dialog that appears on the TV, then submit again.

{detail}

error.invalid_device_id: Device ID must only contain lowercase letters, digits, and underscores.
error.invalid_topic_prefix: Topic prefix may only contain letters, digits, underscores, dashes, and inner slashes (no MQTT wildcards).
error.apk_not_reachable: The APK did not respond on the status topic. Check the APK is running and the device ID matches. You can proceed anyway — state will populate when the APK comes online. Check 'Continue anyway' to proceed.
error.adb_unreachable: Could not reach the Fire TV over ADB. Enable ADB Debugging in Developer Options and check the IP address.
error.adb_auth: The Fire TV rejected the connection. Accept the authorization dialog on the TV and try again.
error.adb_unavailable: The ADB client could not be loaded. Restart Home Assistant after the integration finishes installing its dependency.
error.grant_failed: WRITE_SECURE_SETTINGS could not be granted on this Fire OS build. You'll need to enable permissions manually.
error.download_failed: Could not download the APK from GitHub releases. {detail}
error.no_apk_asset: The latest GitHub release has no APK attached.

abort.mqtt_not_configured: The MQTT integration must be configured before setting up Fire2MQTT.
abort.already_configured: This device ID is already configured.
